content:
**The poller holds one timer handle, a forge halt is not a user pause, and a closed server arms nothing (#1243)**

What: poller.mjs writes its timer only through arm()/disarm() (clear-then-set, no-op once closed), so Resume or a tick settling after a pause can no longer start a second, unstoppable tick chain; state().paused now means the user's pause only, with forgeHalted/forgeHaltReason/remotesLane separate, and Resume never lifts a forge halt; server.mjs armRemoteFollowUp returns once closed, so a recompute in flight at close() arms nothing; lib/git-tree.mjs changeDirNames filters to tree entries for both change-dir readers. Why: round-1 cold review of #1241 (#1201). Learned: a semantics change can make an existing RED test vacuous, still green but no longer reaching the code it protected, so re-run mutations after one; tests that used POST pause/resume as a state probe depended on the old meaning; any timer armed after an await must check a closed flag.
